speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Schizophrenia with secondary Major Depressive Episode. The 4-month history of profound sadness, sleep disturbance, and appetite loss following a 7-month onset of negative symptoms (emptiness) and positive symptoms (auditory hallucinations) indicates a primary psychotic disorder with a superimposed depressive episode. The specific content of the voices ("you are worthless") and the duration confirm a psychotic disorder rather than primary depression or substance-induced psychosis. Treatment should focus on antipsychotic medication and psychotherapy.
